examples.text: Tom está mirando a su pantalla del ordenador..
examples.en: Tom is looking at his computer screen.

examples.text: Los ojos de Tom estaban pegados a la pantalla.
examples.en: Tom's eyes were glued to the screen.

examples.text: Tom continuó mirando fijamente a la pantalla en blanco.
examples.en: Tom continued staring at the blank screen.

examples.text: Tom solo está mirando fijamente la pantalla del ordenador.
examples.en: Tom is just staring at the computer screen.
